name: The Witches Saga: Drown in Purple
source:
"Humans are bad. Humans are evil."

Violetta hated humans just as much as humans hated witches. However, during a war between humans and witches, she was shot down by a human. When she thought she was a goner, she was saved by Indigo, a human living in the deep forest. In exchange for helping her, he wanted her to grow a magical flower for him.

[From [url=https://altila.itch.io/tws-drown-in-purple]itch.io[/url]]
